messages.subject: How to plot a reference line in a plot of means with error bars?
parts:
How can I add a reference line (population mean) to a means plot?

The dataset has test scores for students from different states. I'd like to plot the mean for each each state usign geom_point()+geom_errorbar() and display a reference line with the population to mean to show which states are below or above the pop. mean

Thank you

source("http://agrobiol.sggw.waw.pl/~cbcs/articles/5_2_2/function_www.R")

genotype <- paste("CA", as.roman(1:13), sep = "-")
SE <- c(0.46, 2.11, 1.70, 0.91, 1.35, 0.58, 0.61, 0.70, 0.73, 0.40, 0.51, 0.28, 0.28) 
plant.height <- c(15.38, 16.94, 17.83, 12.06, 15.41,  13.52, 14.31, 14.69, 12.45, 13.31, 8.53, 14.89, 15.25)
lower <- plant.height - SE; upper <- plant.height + SE
x <- data.frame(group = genotype, lower = lower, est = plant.height, upper = upper)
dotplot.errors(x, qlabel = "Mean plant height (cm)", reference=14.50)

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: How to plot a reference line in a plot of means with error bars?
parts:
Hi Ricardo,

Thanks for the example. The basic plot can be constructed with ggplot2
as follows:

x$group <- reorder(x$group, x$est)
ggplot(x, aes(x=group, y=est)) +
geom_point() +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower, ymax=upper)) +
geom_hline(yintercept=14.50) +
coord_flip()


Adding bells and whistles to reproduce the original (not sure if you
care about this):

ggplot(x, aes(x=group, y=est)) +
geom_point(size=3) +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower, ymax=upper),
width=.25,
size=0.3) +
geom_hline(yintercept=14.50, color="gray80") +
scale_y_continuous(name=expression(
paste("Mean plant height (cm)") %+-% SE),
breaks=seq(8, 18, by=2)) +
scale_x_discrete(name="") +
coord_flip() +
theme_bw() +
theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
panel.border = element_rect(color="black"),
panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype=2, size=.5))


Best,
Ista

Thank you Ista! That's exactly what  I was looking for.
I changed the width of the error bars and added the axis labels to the first part of your code.  Below is the final code in case somebody wants to use it.

cheers!

source("http://agrobiol.sggw.waw.pl/~cbcs/articles/5_2_2/function_www.R")
genotype <- paste("CA", as.roman(1:13), sep = "-")
SE <- c(0.46, 2.11, 1.70, 0.91, 1.35, 0.58, 0.61, 0.70, 0.73, 0.40, 0.51,
0.28, 0.28)
plant.height <- c(15.38, 16.94, 17.83, 12.06, 15.41,  13.52, 14.31, 14.69,
12.45, 13.31, 8.53, 14.89, 15.25)
lower <- plant.height - SE; upper <- plant.height + SE
x <- data.frame(group = genotype, lower = lower, est = plant.height, upper =
upper)

x$group <- reorder(x$group, x$est)
ggplot(x, aes(x=group, y=est)) +
    geom_point() +

scale_y_continuous(name=expression(
                           paste("Mean plant height (cm)") %+-% SE),
                       breaks=seq(8, 18, by=2)) +
